blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID) , which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single visual human demonstration. The iterative agentic loop of code refinement requires several key ingredients: (i) a testable task specification, (ii) action primitives for robot execution, and (iii) an interactive environment for program execution and verification. RAPID infers all three from the demonstration automatically. To make the resulting program reusable beyond the demonstration setting, RAPID uses an object-centric relational program representation that focuses on the underlying structure of the demonstrated strategy rather than the specific motion per se : it expresses the action primitives as trajectory-optimization programs that realize object-level motion effects, while composing them through relational constraints that capture scene-specific geometry at run time. We evaluated RAPID in simulation on eight challenging contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks as well as general prehensile manipulation tasks in the LIBERO-Pro benchmark. We also successfully deployed it on a real Franka arm and evaluated on all eight nonprehensile tasks. In all experiments, RAPID demonstrated strong performance, with generalization over object pose, shape, material, and environment. Website: https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid .
blocks.zh: 编码代理人在解决复杂的编程问题上表现出巨大成功. 为了发挥机器人系统的潜力,本作引入了来自演示(RAPID)的机器人代理编程(Robot Agentic programming from Expressions),通过一个单一的视觉人类演示,自动生成,验证和完善机器人程序. 代码完善的迭代代理循环需要几个关键成分:(一)可测试的任务规格,(二)机器人执行的动作原始,(三)程序执行和核查的交互环境. RAPID从演示中自动推断出所有三个. 为了让由此产生的程序在演示设置之外可以重复使用,RAPID使用一个以对象为中心的关系程序表示,它侧重于被演示策略的内在结构,而不是特定运动本身:它表达动作原始,作为实现物体级运动效应的轨迹优化程序,同时通过关系约束来组合它们,在运行时捕捉场景特定几何. 我们在模拟8项具有挑战性的富于接触的非全面操纵任务以及LIBERO-Pro基准中的一般全面操纵任务时对RAPID进行了评估。 我们还成功地将它部署在真正的弗兰卡臂上,并对所有8项非全面任务进行评估。 在所有实验中,RAPID都表现出了强大的性能,对物体的姿势、形状、材料和环境进行了概括。 网站:https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Recently, coding agents [ 1 , 2 ] have shown remarkable capabilities in developing complex software systems, sparking growing interest in solving robotic manipulation tasks through programming [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Consider how a human engineer would develop a robot program for the task in Fig. 1 before the advent of coding agents: given a task (pick up the cereal box), they would implement a program representing the solution strategy (press move → \to push → \to flip → \to grasp), and verify the program on test cases and iteratively debug it. This workflow mirrors the core strength of coding agents: not one-shot code generation, but the iterative cycle of generating, executing, verifying, and revising a program, commonly referred to as the agentic coding loop [ 10 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近,编码代理[1,2]在开发复杂的软件系统方面表现出了卓越的能力,激发了对通过编程解决机器人操纵任务的日益增长的兴趣[3,4,5,6,7,8,9]. 考虑一下人类工程师如何在编码代理出现之前为图1的任务开发机器人程序:赋予任务(捡起谷物盒),他们将执行一个代表解决方案策略的程序(按下动 →\推 →\翻 →\抓住),并在测试案例上验证程序并迭代调试. 这个工作流程反映了编码代理的核心强度:不是一发代码生成,而是生成,执行,核实,以及修订一个程序的迭代周期,通常称为代理编码循环[10,11].

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : RAPID ( R obot A gentic P rogramm i ng from D emonstrations) generates a reusable manipulation program from a single visual human demonstration; the program generalizes across variations in object appearance, pose, geometry, physical properties, and scene configuration.

blocks.en: However, bringing this agentic coding loop to robotic manipulation requires several ingredients that are not readily available: (a) a testable task specification that defines the intended outcome, (b) manipulation primitives that bridge program-level reasoning and low-level execution, and (c) interactive environments for verification. Existing robotic coding-agent systems typically assume these ingredients are provided a priori , through ground-truth rewards and success signals, human-engineered primitives, and resettable environments. This raises a fundamental question: how can we close the agentic coding loop without assuming that these ingredients are provided a priori ?
blocks.zh: 然而,将这种代理编码循环带给机器人操纵需要几种不易获得的成分:(a)可测试的任务规格,确定预期结果;(b)将程序层面的推理和低级执行连接起来的操纵原始物;(c)核查的互动环境。 现有的机器人编码代理系统通常假定通过地面真实的奖励和成功信号、人类工程的原始物和可重置的环境,预先提供这些成分。 这提出了一个根本性的问题:我们如何在不假定这些成分是事先提供的的情况下关闭代理编码循环?

blocks.en: Our key idea is to use demonstrations as the programming interface for supplying the task- and motion-level information needed by the agentic coding loop. A demonstration directly shows a feasible way to accomplish a task and, together with a language description, conveys the intended outcome. Motivated by this perspective, we introduce R obot A gentic P rogramm i ng from D emonstrations ( RAPID ), a framework for generating and iteratively refining robot programs from a single visual human demonstration with a coding agent (Fig. 2 ). From the demonstration, RAPID infers the task specification, constructs manipulation primitives and composes them into a strategy. It further reconstructs an interactive simulation environment from the demonstration for program verification and refinement, and generates scene variants to improve generalization. In this way, a single demonstration bootstraps the task specification, manipulation primitives, and verification environment for closing the agentic coding loop.
blocks.zh: 我们的关键想法是使用演示作为编程接口,提供代理编码循环所需的任务和动作级别信息. 示范直接显示完成任务的可行方式,并连同语文说明一起传达预期结果。 基于这个观点,我们从D演示(RAPID)中引入了R obot A gentic P rogramm i ng,这是通过一个人类单一视觉演示,用编码剂(图2)生成和迭代完善机器人程序的框架. 从演示中,RAPID推断了任务规格,构建了操控原始物并将其编成策略. 它进一步重建了从演示开始的交互式模拟环境,用于程序验证和完善,并生成场景变体来改进概括. 这样,一个单一的演示靴将任务规格,操控原始物,以及关闭代理编码环的验证环境捆绑起来.

blocks.en: Rather than merely reproducing the demonstration, we aim to extract a reusable and generalizable manipulation program. Programs that directly encode poses, distances, or waypoints may succeed in the demonstrated scene, but can fail when the scene changes. In this work, we propose an object-centric relational program representation , where the solution strategy is represented by object-centric relations and effects. Specifically, RAPID writes primitives as local trajectory-optimization programs that realize object-level motion effects, such as pushing an object by a displacement or flipping it by an angle, while resolving scene-dependent geometry at execution time. At the task level, primitives are composed into a strategy through relational constraints that determine how the outcome of one phase specifies the next. For example, in Fig. 3 , rather than replaying a fixed motion, the program first computes the goal position from the relation between the brown obstacle and the white fixture, and then determines how far to move the target object during the current primitive (press move) based on the state produced by the preceding primitive (flip). By expressing primitives and their composition relationally, RAPID preserves the invariant structure of the demonstrated strategy while adapting to changes in object appearance, pose, geometry, physical properties, and scene configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们的目的不是仅仅复制演示,而是要提取一个可重复和通用的操纵程序。 直接编码外观,距离,或路标的程序在所显示的场景中可能成功,但在场景变化时可能失败. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个以对象为中心的关系程序表示,其中以以对象为中心的关系和效果为代表的解决方案策略. 具体来说,RAPID将原始物写成局部的轨迹优化程序,实现对象级运动效应,如通过移位来推动物体或按角度翻转,同时解决执行时的场景依赖几何. 在任务层面,通过关系限制将原始人组成一个战略,决定一个阶段的结果如何指定下一个阶段。 例如,在Fig. 3中,程序不是重放固定运动,而是首先从棕色障碍和白色固定物之间的关系中计算出目标位置,然后根据之前原始物(flip)产生的状态,确定在当前原始物(press move)期间,目标物移动的距离. RAPID通过相对地表达原始物及其组成,在适应物体外观、姿势、几何形状、物理属性和场景配置的变化的同时,保留了所演示策略的无变化结构。

blocks.en: The remaining challenge is verification : the coding agent needs an interactive environment in which candidate programs can be executed, evaluated, and revised. RAPID reconstructs such an environment in simulation from the demonstration and augments it with scene variants generated by perturbing the demonstrated scene. The coding agent then generates task-specific filters that discard variants that are physically infeasible or inconsistent with the task. Afterwards, the coding agent executes candidate programs across this verification set and iteratively revises them based on observed failures.
blocks.zh: 剩下的挑战是核实 : 编码代理需要一个互动的环境, 以便执行、评价和修订候选程序。 RAPID从演示中重建这种环境,并用扰动演示场景所产生的场景变体加以扩充。 然后编码代理生成任务特定过滤器,丢弃物理上不可行或与任务不一致的变体. 之后,编码代理会在整个验证集中执行候选程序,并根据观察到的失败反复修改.

blocks.en: In this work, we focus on nonprehensile manipulation , a particularly challenging domain in robotic manipulation. Many prehensile tasks can be composed from a compact and well-established set of reusable primitives [ 12 ] , such as pick , move in free space , and place . Nonprehensile manipulation, by contrast, involves a much broader range of geometry- and contact-dependent interactions, including pushing [ 13 ] , pivoting [ 14 ] , toppling [ 15 ] , flipping [ 16 ] , and sliding [ 17 ] . Capturing this diversity with a fixed primitive library is difficult, making manual primitive design a substantial engineering burden. Nonprehensile manipulation therefore provides a natural testbed for studying whether a coding agent can construct reusable manipulation primitives from a single demonstration rather than relying on human engineering.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们专注于不全面的操纵,这是机器人操纵中一个特别具有挑战性的领域. 许多综合任务可以由一套紧凑而完善的可重复使用的原始物组成[12],例如采摘、在自由空间中移动和放置。 与此相反,不全面的操纵涉及范围更广的几何学和依赖接触的相互作用,包括推[13]、支点[14]、推倒[15]、翻转[16]和滑动[17]。 用固定的原始库来捕捉这种多样性是很困难的,使得手动的原始设计成为相当大的工程负担. 因此,不全面的操纵提供了一个自然试验台,用于研究编码剂是否可以从单一的演示中构建可重复使用的操纵原始物,而不是依赖人类工程。

blocks.en: We evaluate RAPID on eight contact-rich, multi-step nonprehensile manipulation tasks in simulation, asking whether programs constructed from a single demonstrated instance can generalize to substantial variations in object appearance, pose, geometry, physical properties, and scene configuration. RAPID outperforms baselines without relying on pre-specified success signals, human-engineered manipulation primitives or provided resettable environments. To evaluate the generality of RAPID beyond nonprehensile manipulation, we additionally test it on LIBERO-Pro [ 18 ] , a simulation benchmark featuring prehensile manipulation tasks. Finally, we demonstrate that RAPID can be deployed effectively on a real robotic system.
blocks.zh: 我们评价RAPID在模拟中的8个接触丰富,多步骤的非全面的操纵任务,询问从单一演示实例构建的程序是否能够概括到物体外观、姿势、几何、物理属性和场景配置的巨大差异。 RAPID在不依赖预先指定的成功信号,人机操纵原始或提供可重置环境的情况下,超越了基线. 为了评估RAPID的通用性,除了不全面的操纵外,我们还在LIBERO-Pro [18]上进行测试,这是一个模拟基准,其中包含全面的操纵任务。 最后,我们表明,RAPID可以有效地部署在真正的机器人系统中。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Programming for Robotics. Code as Policies [ 9 ] uses robot programs to connect language reasoning with control. Related work generates programs [ 19 , 20 ] , geometric constraints [ 21 , 22 ] , rewards [ 23 , 24 ] , and simulation environments [ 25 ] . Agentic programming adds iterative execution and refinement: CaP-X [ 6 ] and related systems [ 4 , 8 , 3 , 26 ] improve programs through feedback, while Voyager [ 27 ] and skill-discovery approaches [ 5 , 28 ] grow reusable libraries. However, these approaches typically rely on task success signals, human-engineered primitives, or verification environments supplied a priori . In contrast, RAPID derives these ingredients from a single visual human demonstration to close the agentic coding loop.
blocks.zh: 机器人的编程。 代码为Policy [9] 使用机器人程序将语言推理与控制连接起来. 相关工作产生程序[19,20],几何限制[21,22],奖励[23,24],模拟环境[25]. 代理编程增加了迭代执行和完善: CaP-X [6] 和相关系统[4,8,3,26]通过反馈改进程序,而Voyager [27]和技能发现方法[5,28]则发展为可重复使用的库. 然而,这些方法通常依赖于任务成功信号、人造原始或核查环境提供的先验性。 与此相对照,RAPID通过单一的视觉人类演示获得这些成分,以关闭代理编码循环.

blocks.en: Learning from Few Demonstrations. Learning from few demonstrations benefits from representations that preserve task-relevant structure across objects and scenes. Spatial abstractions support transfer through visual alignment [ 29 ] , object geometry and correspondence [ 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 ] , and contact or interaction structure [ 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] . Demonstrations can also be decomposed into subgoals and primitives [ 38 , 39 ] . Structured skill representations enable long-horizon planning and composition through contact retargeting, symbolic models, or geometric reasoning [ 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 , 44 ] . However, these representations are generally embedded in fixed learning or planning pipelines. In contrast, RAPID combines an object-centric relational program representation of manipulation effects and composition constraints with agentic programming to iteratively construct, verify, and refine transferable manipulation strategies.
blocks.zh: 从少数示威学习。 从为数不多的示范中学习,从保留与任务相关的不同物体和场景结构的表述中获益。 空间抽象支持通过视觉对齐[29],对象几何和对应[30,31,32,33],以及接触或交互结构[34,35,36,37]进行转移. 演示还可以分解成次级目标和原始的[38,39]. 结构化技能表现能够通过联系重定向、象征性模型或几何推理[40、41、42、43、44]进行长视距规划和组成。 然而,这些表述一般都包含在固定学习或规划的管道中. 相比之下,RAPID将以对象为中心的关系程序代表操纵效应和组成限制与代理编程相结合,以迭代构造,验证和完善可转移的操纵策略.

blocks.en: Nonprehensile Manipulation. Nonprehensile manipulation exploits environmental contact to reposition objects and enable otherwise difficult grasps [ 45 ] . Prior work develops mechanics-based models [ 46 , 14 ] , contact-aware planners [ 47 , 15 , 17 ] , and optimization methods for trajectories and primitives [ 48 , 49 , 50 , 51 ] . Learning-based approaches acquire contact-rich policies [ 52 , 53 , 54 ] or compose predefined primitives [ 55 ] . However, these methods typically rely on explicit task specifications or task-specific policy training. In contrast, RAPID approaches nonprehensile manipulation through agentic programming from a single visual human demonstration, automatically constructing and iteratively refining the required primitives and their composition.
blocks.zh: 不拘泥于操纵. 不全面的操纵利用环境接触来重新定位物体,并使得在其他方面难以掌握[45]。 之前的工作开发了基于力学的模型[46,14],接触意识规划[47,15,17],以及轨迹和原始物的优化方法[48,49,50,51]. 基于学习的方法获得丰富的接触政策[52,53,54]或构成预先定义的原始物[55]. 然而,这些方法通常依靠明确的任务规格或具体任务的政策培训。 相比之下,RAPID则通过单一的视觉人类演示的代理编程,进行不全面的操纵,自动构建并迭代精炼所需的原始物及其组成.

blocks.en: Program Representation. We introduce an object-centric relational program representation that enables strategies constructed by the agent to generalize across different scenes. RAPID represents each primitive as a geometry- and physics-aware local trajectory-optimization program that achieves an object-level effect. A strategy then composes these primitives through relational constraints that specify the desired effect of each primitive. We detail this representation in Sec. IV .
blocks.zh: 方案代表。 我们引入了以对象为中心的关系程序代表,使代理商构建的策略能够跨越不同的场景进行概括. RAPID作为几何学和物理学认知的局部轨迹优化程序代表每个原始物,实现物体级效应. 然后一种策略通过关系限制来组成这些原始物,这些限制规定了每个原始物的预期效果. 我们在第四节详细介绍了这一陈述。

blocks.en: Strategy Construction. As shown in Fig. 2 , RAPID closes the agentic coding loop by deriving task specifications, manipulation primitives, and verification environments from ( D , l ) (D,l) . It segments the demonstration into several phases, infers a subgoal and success predicate for each phase, and performs real-to-sim reconstruction to obtain interactive simulation environments. RAPID further synthesizes feasible scene variants for additional verification. For each phase, the coding agent generates a primitive and iteratively executes, verifies, and revises it across the reconstructed environment and its variants. RAPID then infers the overall task goal and success predicate, composes the primitives into a strategy, and refines the composition through the same loop. We describe this construction and verification process in Sec. V .
blocks.zh: 战略建设. 如图2所示,RAPID通过从(D,l) (D,l) 得出任务规格、操纵原始物和核查环境来关闭代理编码循环。 它将示范分为几个阶段,推断每个阶段都有次级目标和成功前提,并进行实景重建,以获得互动模拟环境。 RAPID进一步综合了可行的场景变体,以进行额外的核查. 对于每个阶段,编码代理生成一个原始的和迭代的执行,验证,并在重建的环境及其变体中修改. RAPID然后推断总体任务目标和成功前提,将原始人编成战略,并通过同一循环来完善组成. 我们在第五节中描述了这一构建和核查进程。

blocks.en: Strategy Deployment. At deployment, given an RGB-D observation of a novel scene and a language instruction, RAPID reconstructs the scene in simulation, instantiates the strategy in the reconstructed scene, and executes the resulting trajectory on the robot. Lightweight semantic binding assigns scene objects to the semantic roles in the strategy, while the strategy and primitives themselves remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 战略部署。 在部署时,由于对一个新场景的RGB-D观察和语言指示,RAPID在模拟中重建场景,在重建的场景中即时发挥策略作用,并在机器人上执行由此产生的轨迹. 轻量语义约束将场景对象分配给策略中的语义角色,而策略和原始人本身则保持不变.

blocks.en: IV Object-Centric Relational Programs
blocks.zh: 四. 对象关系方案

blocks.en: We now define our object-centric relational program representation: primitives (Sec. IV-A ), their composition into task-level strategies (Sec. IV-B ), and strategy instantiation in novel scenes (Sec. IV-C ).
blocks.zh: 我们现在定义了以对象为中心的关系程序代表:原始人(Sec. IV-A),他们组成任务级战略(Sec. IV-B),以及新场景中的策略即时化(Sec. IV-C).

blocks.en: IV-A Primitives as Local Trajectory-Optimization Programs
blocks.zh: IV-A 本地轨道优化方案

blocks.en: A primitive is a reusable behavior for realizing an object-level motion effect, such as pushing an object by a displacement or flipping an object by an angle. We represent a primitive as a local relational trajectory-optimization program P i = ( G i , C i , Ψ i , ρ i , J i ) ∈ 𝒫 . P_{i}=(G_{i},C_{i},\Psi_{i},\rho_{i},J_{i})\in\mathcal{P}. Here, G i G_{i} is a semantic, object-centric description of the intended effect; C i C_{i} is the relational interface; Ψ i \Psi_{i} is the verifiable success condition; ρ i \rho_{i} is the geometry resolver; and J i J_{i} is the optimization cost. Together, these components specify how the primitive is instantiated, optimized, and verified in a specific scene. A primitive is therefore neither a fixed trajectory nor a black-box policy. Table I illustrates each component for flipping an object against a fixture.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 RAPID
blocks.zh: 算法 1 RAPID

blocks.en: We now describe how RAPID constructs and verifies the programs defined in Sec. IV , covering environment reconstruction, primitive construction, and strategy composition.
blocks.zh: 我们现在描述RAPID如何构建和验证第IV节界定的方案,涵盖环境重建、原始建筑和战略组成。

blocks.en: V-A Reconstructing Interactive Environments
blocks.zh: V-A 重建互动环境

blocks.en: Interactive Environment. To verify a manipulation program, RAPID reconstructs an interactive simulation environment from the initial RGB-D frame of the demonstration. We first use a vision-language model (VLM) to identify the objects in the scene, assign semantic labels to them, and estimate their physical properties. Then, for each semantic name, we utilize SAM 3 [ 57 ] to get a segmentation mask. The RGB-D frame and the mask are then fed into SAM 3D [ 58 ] to reconstruct a complete mesh. Finally, we use FoundationPose [ 59 ] to register each mesh to the RGB-D frame and assemble the reconstructed objects and robot model in MuJoCo [ 60 ] . The resulting environment preserves the scene entities, geometry, and spatial relations needed to execute the candidate program and evaluate its success predicates.
blocks.zh: 互动环境. 为了验证一个操纵程序,RAPID从演示的初始RGB-D框架重建一个交互式模拟环境. 我们首先使用视觉语言模型(VLM)来识别场景中的物体,给它们分配语义标签,并估计其物理属性. 然后,对于每个语义名称, 我们利用SAM 3 [57] 得到一个分割面罩。 然后将RGB-D框架和面具输入SAM 3D [58]重建完整的网格. 最后,我们使用FoundationPose [59] 将每个网格注册到RGB-D框架,并在MujoCo [60] 组装重建的物体和机器人模型. 由此产生的环境保留了执行候选程序和评价其成功上游所需的场景实体,几何学和空间关系.

blocks.en: Feasible Scene Variants. To construct variants of the demonstrated scene, RAPID uses a task-agnostic variation sampler to randomize object appearances, sizes, poses, and physical parameters such as mass, friction, and elasticity. However, the randomly sampled scenes might not be feasible for a certain primitive or strategy. Therefore, we ask the coding agent to write a filter for each primitive or strategy that accepts only variants preserving the declared roles and relations, task meaning, and physical feasibility.
blocks.zh: 实际场景变体. 为了构建演示场景的变种,RAPID使用任务不可知变种采样器随机排列物体外观,大小,姿势,以及质量,摩擦,弹性等物理参数. 然而,随机取样的场景对于某种原始或策略来说可能并不可行. 因此,我们请编码代理为每个原始或策略写一个过滤器,它只接受保留声明的角色和关系,任务意义,以及物理可行性的变体.

blocks.en: V-B Primitive Construction
blocks.zh: V-B 原始建筑

blocks.en: Given the full demonstration D D and its natural language description l l , RAPID calls a subagent to partition D D into an ordered sequence of interaction segments ( D 1 , … , D K ) (D_{1},\ldots,D_{K}) and assign a local description l i l_{i} to each D i D_{i} . For each ( D i , l i ) (D_{i},l_{i}) , if the coding agent recognizes that the behavior is covered by an existing primitive in the primitive library 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , we can simply retrieve this primitive. Otherwise, the coding agent will infer a primitive specification consisting of a semantic goal G i G_{i} and a success predicate Ψ i \Psi_{i} from ( D i , l i ) (D_{i},l_{i}) . blocks.en: Benchmark. We construct a simulation benchmark in MuJoCo [ 60 ] using a Franka Research 3 robot arm equipped with a compliant operational-space controller [ 61 ] . Our primary evaluation metric is generalization . For each of the 8 tasks, we construct 50 novel test scenes that differ from the demonstration scene in object pose, appearance, size, shape, and material. We also introduce irrelevant objects to make the test scenes visually distracting. We evaluate each method by measuring its success rate on each task using a private success criterion hidden from RAPID. We run three trials of each experiment and report the mean and standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们在MujoCo[60]构建一个模拟基准,使用配备了符合要求的操作空间控制器的Franka Research 3机器人臂[61]. 我们的主要评价尺度是概括。 对于8项任务中的每一项,我们构建了50个与演示场景不同的新颖的试验场景,这些场景以物体的姿势,外观,体积,形状,和材料等不同. 我们还引入了无关的物体,使试验场景在视觉上分散注意力. 我们通过使用RAPID隐藏的私人成功标准衡量每项任务的成功率来评估每一种方法。 我们每个实验进行三次试验,报告平均和标准的偏差。

Baselines. We compare six approaches along three principal axes: the closed agentic loop ( Agent ), the o bject-centric re lational p rogram representation ( OReP ), and synthesized s cene v ariants ( SV ). 1) Open-loop + Python (CaP) : For each novel test scene, we use Code as Policies (CaP) [ 9 ] to generate a Python program conditioned on the demonstration, language description, and observation, without simulation feedback during program generation. 2) Open-loop + OReP (CaP + OReP) : We augment CaP with our OReP and cross-entropy method (CEM) optimizer, enabling motions to be expressed relative to scene entities. 3) Agent + Python (CaP-Agent0) : We use CaP-Agent0 from CaP-X [ 6 ] to assess the benefit of our program representation.
We give CaP-Agent0 a more favorable agentic-programming setting than that of RAPID: during program construction, it receives rollout feedback consisting of ground-truth success signals, environment states, and visual observations; at evaluation time, it may additionally execute rollouts in each test scene and revise its program. 4) Agent + Python + SV (CaP-Agent0 + SV) : We further augment CaP-Agent0 with our scene-variant generation module, allowing it to refine its program on synthesized scene variants. 5) Agent + OReP (RAPID w/o SV) : We remove the scene-variant generation module from RAPID. 6) Agent + OReP + SV (RAPID) : Our full method.
Comparisons of 4) vs. 3) and 6) vs. 5) isolate the benefit of variant-based verification. We do not compare with ASPIRE [ 5 ] on nonprehensile tasks because it requires motion primitives to be provided. We use Codex [ 1 ] powered by GPT-5.6 Sol with high reasoning effort as the coding agent and provide the same robot control APIs for all methods.

blocks.zh: VI-B 非全面操纵模拟实验

blocks.en: RAPID successfully constructs reusable programs by closing the agentic loop from a single demonstration. As shown in Table II , vanilla CaP performs poorly despite being allowed to generate a program tailored to each test scene. Without an interactive environment for verifying its programs, the agent cannot check whether the proposed motions produce the intended object interactions. Augmenting CaP with our object-centric relational program representation does not improve its performance either, suggesting that the representation alone is insufficient: without closed-loop verification, the coding agent struggles to reason about object relations and therefore fails to construct meaningful relational programs. In contrast, RAPID reconstructs a simulation environment from the demonstration, infers a success predicate from the demonstration and language instruction, and uses this predicate to verify and iteratively refine candidate programs in simulation. In this way, RAPID constructs a reusable program for each task that generalizes across diverse test scenes. In our experiments, this construction takes on the order of tens of minutes per task. This cost is incurred once per task: the resulting strategy and primitives remain fixed across the 50 novel scenes, with semantic role binding taking only a few seconds per scene.
blocks.zh: RAPID通过关闭单个演示的代理循环,成功构建了可重复使用的程序. 如表二所示,Vanilla CaP尽管被允许制作适合每个试验场景的程序,但表现不佳。 没有用于验证其程序的互动环境,代理无法检查拟议运动是否产生预期对象相互作用. 用我们以对象为中心的关系程序代表来增强CaP,也并不能改善它的性能,说明这个代表本身是不够的:没有闭路验证,编码代理就难以对对象关系进行推理,因此无法构建有意义的关系程序. 相比之下,RAPID从演示中重建一个模拟环境,推断演示和语言教学的成功前提,并利用这个前提在模拟中验证和迭代完善候选程序. 通过这种方式,RAPID为每项任务构建了一个可重复使用的程序,该程序概括了各种测试场景. 在我们的实验中,这种构造每任务需要数十分钟左右. 这种成本是每个任务一次发生的:所产生的策略和原始物仍然固定在50个新剧场面上,语义角色绑定每个剧场只占用几秒钟.

blocks.en: The object-centric relational program representation enhances the generalization of the strategy program. The comparison with the two CaP-Agent0 baselines in Table II supports the benefit of our program representation: even with stronger verification access, including ground-truth feedback and evaluation-time refinement, CaP-Agent0 substantially underperforms RAPID. Although CaP-Agent0 incorporates state feedback, its generated policies often use fixed world-frame offsets and predetermined timing, limiting spatial generalization and robustness to state deviations during execution. In contrast, RAPID computes geometry-dependent subgoals from the state reached after each preceding phase. The gap is even larger for contact-rich, forceful behaviors such as flipping and toppling, which are naturally expressed by our relational, optimization-based motion primitives.
blocks.zh: 以对象为中心的关系程序表现可以增强战略方案的概括性. 与表二中两个CaP-Agent0基线的比较支持了我们方案代表性的好处:即使有了更强的核查准入,包括地面真实反馈和评价时间的改进,CaP-Agent0也大大低于RAPID。 虽然CaP-Agent0包含了国家的反馈,但其产生的政策往往使用固定的世界范围抵消和预先确定的时间,将空间泛化和稳健性限制在执行过程中的偏差状态. 与此相对照,RAPID从每个前阶段之后达到的状态计算出几何学依赖的子目标. 对于接触丰富,强力的行为,如翻转和翻转,差距甚至更大,这自然是由我们的关系性,优化性运动原始人来表达的.

blocks.en: Ablation study of scene variant generation. To evaluate the effectiveness of scene variant generation, we remove it from RAPID and report the results in Table II . Except for Tasks 1 and 2, the performance of RAPID drops substantially, while the standard deviation of the success rate increases, indicating reduced stability and robustness. Interestingly, augmenting CaP-Agent0 with scene variant generation does not improve its performance. This suggests that, without our object-centric relational program representation, CaP-Agent0 struggles to construct a generalizable program that can solve diverse generated variants without overfitting to individual scenes.
blocks.zh: 场景变种生成的偏差研究. 为了评价场景变异生成的效果,我们从RAPID中删除了它,并在表二中报告结果。 除任务1和2外,RAPID的性能大幅下降,而成功率的标准偏差增加,表明稳定性和稳健性下降。 有趣的是,用场景变体生成来增强CaP-Agent0并不能提高其性能. 这表明,如果没有我们以对象为中心的关系程序代表,CaP-Agent0会挣扎构建一个通用程序,这个程序可以解决生成的多样变体而不会过度适应单个场景.

blocks.en: Experimental Setup. To demonstrate the general applicability of RAPID beyond nonprehensile manipulation, we evaluate it on LIBERO-Pro [ 18 ] , an extension of LIBERO [ 62 ] with stronger position (Pos.) and instruction (Task.) perturbations. LIBERO-Pro predominantly features prehensile tasks, including pick-and-place and grasp-based articulated-object manipulation. We compare against two groups of baselines: (1) vision-language-action (VLA) models, including OpenVLA [ 63 ] , π 0 \pi_{0} [ 64 ] , and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 65 ] , whose results are directly taken from the LIBERO-Pro paper; and (2) code-as-policy (CaP) methods, including CaP-Agent0 [ 6 ] and ASPIRE [ 5 ] . For a fair comparison with CaP methods, which do not use demonstrations, RAPID also receives no demonstrations and is given only the task description and a single debug scene. This setting is more restrictive than the setting used by ASPIRE, which uses 15 debug scenes per task. Moreover, while CaP baselines are provided with predefined motion primitives such as grasping, placing, and transporting, RAPID must discover and implement these primitives solely through exploration and iterative refinement in the debug scene.

blocks.en: Results. Table III reports the results on LIBERO-Pro. RAPID achieves the highest success rate on five of the six task settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of our object-centric relational program representation. On LIBERO-Goal (Pos.), RAPID ranks second behind ASPIRE. This gap stems from articulated-object manipulation: primitives discovered by RAPID from only a single debug scene, such as drawer opening, are less robust to spatial variation, whereas ASPIRE is provided with an interpolate segment motion primitive that simplifies such interactions. Overall, these results demonstrate the generality of our framework beyond nonprehensile manipulation.
blocks.zh: 结果。 表三汇报了LIBERO-Pro. RAPID在六个任务设置中的五个实现最高成功率的结果,显示了我们以对象为中心的关系方案代表的有效性. 在LIBERO-GOAL(Pos.)上,RAPID排在ASPIRE的第二位. 这种差距源于清晰的物体操纵:RAPID只从一个单一的调试场景(如抽屉开口)中发现的原始物比空间变异性更弱,而ASPIRE则得到一个插座片段运动原始物,简化了这种相互作用. 总的来说,这些结果表明,我们的框架超越了不全面的操纵。

blocks.en: To demonstrate that RAPID can operate effectively on a real robotic system, we conduct real-world experiments on the eight nonprehensile manipulation tasks shown in Fig. 4 . As illustrated in Fig. 5 , our setup consists of a Franka Research 3 robot arm equipped with a parallel gripper and an Intel RealSense L515 camera for RGB-D observations. We compare RAPID against CaP-Agent0 [ 6 ] . For each task, we evaluate 10 test scenes and report the success rate.

blocks.en: Results. As shown in Fig. 5 , with our object-centric relational program representation and compliant operational-space controller, contact-rich nonprehensile behaviors optimized in simulation can be transferred directly to the real robot and executed effectively. In contrast, CaP-Agent0 struggles to generate reliable trajectories using procedural programs. Moreover, leveraging the VLM’s prior knowledge to estimate physical parameters such as mass, friction, and restitution, together with SAM 3D’s strong 3D reconstruction capability, helps keep the real-to-sim and sim-to-real gaps manageable.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: We presented RAPID, a framework that closes the agentic coding loop for robotic manipulation from a single visual human demonstration and a language description. By automatically deriving task specifications, manipulation primitives, and interactive verification environments, RAPID enables a coding agent to construct, execute, and iteratively refine reusable manipulation strategies. Our object-centric relational program representation represents manipulation primitives as trajectory-optimization programs and composes them with relational constraints, enabling generalization to novel scenes. Experiments on eight contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks demonstrate strong generalization across object and scene variations, while evaluations on LIBERO-Pro and a real robotic system support RAPID’s broader applicability and practical deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了RAPID, 这个框架关闭了机器人操作的代理编码循环 从单一的视觉人类演示和语言描述。 RAPID通过自动得出任务规格,操控原始和交互核查环境,使编码代理能够构建,执行,并迭代完善可重复使用的操控策略. 我们以对象为中心的关系程序代表了作为轨迹优化程序的操纵原始人,并以关系约束来编曲,使得通俗化到新场景. 对8项接触丰富的非全面操纵任务的实验显示,对物体和场景的变异有强烈的概括性,而对LIBERO-Pro和真正的机器人系统的评价则支持RAPID更广泛的适用性和实际部署。

blocks.en: In future work, RAPID will incorporate other tools for learning primitives, such as reinforcement learning for manipulation with dexterous hands. Further, RAPID will automatically benefit from the relentless progress in coding agents, robot foundation models, and simulation engines (e.g., for deformable objects [ 66 ] ), and scale up.
blocks.zh: 在今后的工作中,RAPID将纳入其他学习原始人的工具,例如强化学习,用狡猾的手操纵。 此外,RAPID将自动受益于编码剂、机器人基础模型和模拟引擎(例如,可变形物体[66])的不断进步,并逐步扩大。
